rubric.why: Checking that a transaction is being made through a trustworthy, secure service helps avoid fraudulent transactions.
rubric.description: Use a trusted and secure website or payment service.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for advising the student to verify the website or service before paying.

rubric.why: Keeping sensitive payment and account information private helps prevent misuse.
rubric.description: Do not share passwords, OTPs or payment details.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for advising the student to keep sensitive credentials or payment information private.

modelAnswer: Make online transactions only through trusted, secure websites or payment services.

items.followUp: What is the function of a router in a computer network?

rubric.why: A router links networks so that devices on different networks can communicate.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying that a router connects networks.

rubric.why: Routing packets toward their destination is the router's key function.
rubric.description: Forwards data packets toward their destination.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing packet forwarding or routing.

modelAnswer: A router is a networking device that connects two or more networks.
It forwards data packets to their appropriate destination.

items.followUp: Name the basic components needed for data communication.

rubric.why: Data communication involves the exchange or transfer of data.
rubric.description: Defines data communication as the exchange or transfer of data.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that data is exchanged or transferred.

rubric.why: Communication takes place between devices through a medium.
rubric.description: Mentions communicating devices and/or the communication medium.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the devices involved or the medium used.

modelAnswer: Data communication is the exchange of data between two or more devices.
The data is sent through a communication medium.

items.followUp: What is the difference between a client and a server?

rubric.why: A server makes resources or services available to other computers.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a server provides resources or services.

rubric.why: A client requests or uses the services and resources provided by a server.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a client requests or uses server resources or services.

modelAnswer: A server is a computer that provides services or resources to other computers.
A client is a computer that requests or uses the services or resources provided by a server.

items.followUp: What is a point-to-point connection, and how does it differ from a multipoint connection?

rubric.why: A point-to-point connection is a direct link dedicated to two devices.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the connection directly links two devices.

rubric.why: The link's capacity is used by the two connected devices rather than shared among several devices.
rubric.description: States that the link connects two devices and is not shared among multiple devices.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that the connection is dedicated to the two devices or its capacity is not shared.

modelAnswer: A point-to-point connection is a direct link between two devices.
The link is dedicated to these devices, so its capacity is not shared with other devices.

items.followUp: Give an example of a nested list in Python and explain why it is nested.

rubric.why: A nested list is defined by a list occurring as an element of another list.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a list is inside another list.

rubric.why: The example contains lists as elements of an outer list.
rubric.description: Provides a valid example of a nested list.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct nested-list example.

modelAnswer: A nested list is a list that contains another list as one or more of its elements.

items.followUp: What does the data link layer do in the OSI model?

rubric.why: The physical layer is the lowest layer of the OSI model.
rubric.description: Identifies the physical layer as the lowest OSI layer.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying its position in the OSI model.

rubric.why: The physical layer handles the transmission of raw bits over the physical medium.
rubric.description: Describes its role in transmitting bits over a physical medium.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it transmits raw bits or identifying the physical medium.

modelAnswer: The physical layer is the lowest layer of the OSI model.
It transmits raw bits through the physical communication medium.
